Contract ManageUserCRUDService::deleteUser(userid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		user: User = User.allInstance()->any(u|u.UserID = userid)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		user.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		User.allInstance()->excludes(user) and
		result = true or
		user.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		User.allInstance()->excludes(user) and
		result = false
}
